title: HDL Cosimulation
source_docs: HDL Verifier/For Use with Cadence Xcelium/HDL_Cosimulation.md
text: Cosimulate HDL design by connecting Simulink with HDL simulator, 1 input, 1 output, {I/O Mode} sets Port direction Input; {Block Info} sets the block information for Vivado cosimulation Read-only: block generation, {Enable direct feedthrough} sets the work around algebraic loop warnings, {Full HDL Name} sets the signal path name string, {HDL Type} sets the type of HDL port signal, {HDL Dims} sets the dimension of HDL port signal Read-only, {Sample Time} sets the time between reading samples on an output, {Data Type} sets the simulink Data type for output signal, {Sign}, {Fraction Length} sets the number of fractional bits in output data type, {Simulink Word Length} sets the bit width of Simulink port, {HDL Word Length} sets the bit width of HDL port, {Time to run HDL simulator before cosimulation starts} sets the time required for HDL simulation before cosimulation, {Active Clock Edge} sets the hDL clock edge used to sample signals, {Waveform Type} sets the generate waveforms to drive clocks, resets, or enables to HDL design, {Period/Duration} sets the clock period, {Automatically determine timescale at start of simulation} sets when to calculate automatic timescale, {1 second in Simulink corresponds to in the HDL simulator} sets the timing relationship between Simulink and HDL simulator integer and time, {Connection mode} sets the connection between Simulink and HDL simulator Full, {HDL simulator is running on this computer} sets the same host for HDL simulator and Simulink, {Connection method} sets the connection between HDL simulator and Simulink, {Host name} sets the hDL simulator host, {Port number or service} sets the socket port number string, {Show connection info on icon} adds connection parameters on block icon, {Pre-simulation Tcl commands} sets the commands to run in HDL simulator before cosimulation and {Post-simulation Tcl commands} sets the commands to run in HDL simulator after cosimulation. Values come from the instance.
